facts.fact: The MINFOPRA-KOICA steering committee, meeting on 20 August 2026, reviewed a project launched in 2024 to build civil servants' digital skills through e-government tools, including Smart Campus sites at four institutions and the design documents and training plans for a Learning Management System for continuing training of public agents.
facts.system: Projet d'accélération de la sensibilisation numérique et du renforcement des capacités (MINFOPRA-KOICA)
